basics.name: Md Rayhan Chowdhury
basics.label: Graduate Research Assistant, Electrical & Computer Engineering, Lamar University
basics.summary: M.S. student in Electrical and Computer Engineering at Lamar University and a member of the HESCA Research Lab, advised by Dr. Farah Ferdaus. My research applies machine learning and deep learning to multi-horizon solar power forecasting, with ongoing work toward net load forecasting, fault detection, and cybersecurity for grid resiliency. Before returning to graduate school I spent twelve years in industry across power plant erection and commissioning, consumer electronics, and electric mobility.

work.summary: HESCA Research Lab, Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering. Advised by Dr. Farah Ferdaus.
highlights: Develop machine learning and deep learning models for multi-horizon solar power forecasting on real plant operating data.
Build comparative pipelines across linear and polynomial regression, random forest, and artificial neural networks, with horizon-resolved RMSE and R-squared evaluation from one to ten days ahead.
Extend the forecasting framework toward net load forecasting, fault detection, and cybersecurity for grid resiliency.
Presented research at the 4th Annual Graduate Research Conference, Lamar University, April 2026.
